text: hi sorry I'm 15 and I'm looking after my little brother he's 3, my mum's on her way back but she's like an hour away and she said to message here. He's got a really high temperature, the thermometer says 39.6. I was changing his top and I think there are some spots but it's really hard to see on his skin because he's dark. So I looked at the lighter bits like his palms and the bottom of his feet, and there are these tiny dark red dots on them, and I think a couple inside his mouth on the cheek bit too. I pressed a glass on his palm like I saw online and they didn't go away, I could still see them through it. I don't know if I did it right. I'm really scared, I don't know what to do. Should I call an ambulance or wait for mum?
